params.body:
Own stock (the S numbers, `own = true`) was always sorted before partner stock: in the vehicle list, whatever sort the visitor chose, and in the similar vehicles on a detail page. It no longer needs to come first.

## What changes

- `VehicleController@index`: no `orderByDesc('own')` ahead of the chosen sort. The default stays newest registration first.
- `similar()`: same, newest first within each tier.

Unchanged: no label on own or partner stock, the "Te bezichtigen in Oudenburg" filter (`bezichtigen=1`) still lists own stock only, and the detail page still says "In Oudenburg-Roksem" or "Op afspraak".

## Checks

- `FilterPanelTest::test_own_stock_follows_the_sort_without_a_label`: the own Volvo (2015) now comes after the newer MAN (2019); the filter and the detail page lines as before.
- `php artisan test`: 61 passed
- `vendor/bin/pint --test`: passed
params.title: Stock list: own stock no longer forced to the top
